technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the increment in the existing s-c-s repository using its established module structure, build system, naming conventions, configuration model, and testing patterns.
Target Java 17 or later, consistent with Spring Framework 6 requirements.

Port the Log, field-value-counter, aggregate-counter, gauge, and rich-gauge modules from XD by adapting interfaces and configuration rather than rewriting their core behavior, while preserving documented XD semantics.
Implement Kinesis as a configurable sink using the AWS SDK and the repository's standard message-to-sink abstraction, including stream, region, credentials, partition-key, and endpoint configuration.
Implement the job DSL as a programmatic workflow-definition and orchestration option integrated with the existing job model, while retaining existing non-DSL job configuration options.

Implement the Flink processor using the repository's supported streaming processor abstraction and a compatible Flink version, with configuration and lifecycle handling isolated from application-specific machine-learning logic.
Use unit tests for module behavior, configuration binding, serialization, and error handling; use focused integration tests for Kinesis, job execution, and Flink lifecycle interactions.
Provide backward-compatible public configuration defaults where possible and document any renamed or newly required properties.
assumptions: The s-c-s repository, XD source code, build infrastructure, and existing module examples are available and buildable.
The increment is implemented by one software developer, so estimates represent total hands-on work-hours and exclude elapsed calendar time.
Existing framework abstractions for sources, processors, sinks, messaging, configuration properties, and job execution can be reused without major redesign.
The requested modules are standard XD modules with no undocumented custom business behavior or incompatible licenses.
AWS credentials, Kinesis test resources, and Flink test/runtime dependencies can be supplied through configuration or test fixtures; provisioning production infrastructure is out of scope.
The job DSL requirement concerns exposing and executing workflow/job definitions, not building a new visual designer or a completely new orchestration engine.
The Flink processor requirement covers integration and pass-through processing abstractions; implementing new streaming machine-learning algorithms is out of scope.
Documentation consists of module reference material, configuration examples, and basic usage samples rather than a complete user guide.
Code review, release approval, and external stakeholder sign-off are represented by validation and regression activities but do not require separate calendar-duration estimates.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the s-c-s and XD repositories, identify reusable abstractions, map each user story to modules and acceptance behavior, and produce the implementation plan and dependency impact assessment.
Create or update module structure, build descriptors, dependency management, Java 17 compatibility, configuration conventions, test fixtures, and local development setup needed by the increment.

Implement the Kinesis sink, including AWS SDK integration, message conversion, stream and partition-key configuration, credential and endpoint handling, error behavior, lifecycle management, unit tests, and a focused integration test.
Port the Log sink from XD to the s-c-s module model, adapt configuration and message handling, preserve logging semantics, and add unit and integration-level tests.

Define the DSL API and parsing or builder model, connect DSL-created definitions to job registration and execution, support workflow orchestration semantics, validate errors, and add representative end-to-end tests.
Adapt the field-value-counter sink to s-c-s contracts, configuration binding, message and state handling, and provide behavior and configuration tests.
Adapt the aggregate-counter sink, including aggregation state, counter updates, output behavior, configuration, and tests for normal, empty, and repeated input cases.
Port the gauge sink, adapt its metric/value handling and configuration, preserve XD behavior, and implement unit and focused integration tests.
Port the rich-gauge sink with its richer metric dimensions and value model, adapt serialization and configuration, and add representative compatibility tests.
Implement the Flink processor option, dependency and runtime integration, configuration and lifecycle management, message-to-Flink adaptation, failure handling, and processor-focused tests.

Verify module discovery, configuration metadata, serialization, pipeline composition, dependency conflicts, startup and shutdown behavior, and representative streaming workflows across the new modules.
Document module purpose, configuration properties, prerequisites, migration notes from XD, Kinesis setup, job DSL examples, Flink usage, and representative streaming pipeline definitions.
Run the complete existing and new test suites, investigate failures, correct implementation or compatibility defects, and perform targeted regression verification.
Update CI build and test workflows, verify artifact packaging and dependency metadata, check licensing and generated documentation, and prepare the increment for merge and release.
